verses.mystical_translation: A duplicate poem can preserve history through its differences.
The poem enters through corruption, practical atheism, oppression, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when fear, power, memory, and relationship are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
